steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation as required by the case.
Allow the buyer to add vendors during event creation and publish.
Set the project title required by the case.
Configure the project with an RFQ-only stage, matching the requested final composition.
Configure the RFQ stage.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add the requested CYLINDER line item with quantity 10.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet so the event can be published.
Set the requested delivery location on the line item.

args.goal: On the buyer's RFQ eRFX create screen, open Add T&Cs, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", set "Payment within 45 days" to Required, leave "Delivery within 7 days" as None, click Done, and stop with the project-level terms saved.

steps.note: Configure the two project-level clauses and their required/optional states; no dedicated catalog step edits T&Cs.
Invite one QA test vendor for the vendor-side acceptance and quote.
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Publish the configured RFQ eRFX project.
Verify that publishing reached a real project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open this event's RFQ pricing round in the vendor portal.
Verify that the required project-level clause is shown to the vendor.
Verify that the optional project-level clause is also shown to the vendor.
Accept the displayed terms and submit a quote of 100 for the line item; vendor_bid handles the required clause checkboxes before submission.
Assert that the vendor's quote and accepted terms were submitted successfully.
